meta.name: eol-checklist
meta.description: Build a phase-gated EOL checklist sized to the sunset, with a named owner on every item. Use when the decision to retire is made and you need the operational plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定分阶段的产品退役清单,每项落实到人
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正负责某个产品或服务的退役,需要将收尾工作拆解并落实到具体负责人
copy.tagline_en: Create a phase-gated product retirement checklist with an owner for each item.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing a product sunset and need a structured operational plan with clear ownership.

howto.what: Claude 会把退役决定变成一份分阶段停用检查清单,按复杂度选轻/标准/重型,每项有动词、负责部门和阶段,并覆盖数据、合同、访问、资金,附阶段门条件、事后行动与假设。
howto.when: 当退役决定已做出、你需要运营计划时触发;典型入口是你告诉 Claude 要停用什么产品并附上规模或日期,信息不足时它会先问最多三个问题。

say.text: 给旧版报表模块做 EOL 清单,12 月底停用,约 400 个账户。
say.note: Claude 会生成标准级分阶段清单,每项有负责人。

say.text: 为硬件线做重型停用清单,含服务合同和 8 家经销商。
say.note: Claude 会启用全部六个阶段与门条件,生成跨职能计划。

say.text: 内部工具退役,做轻量清单,用户很少、无外部合同。
say.note: Claude 会给出简短清单,并说明不适用阶段。

howto.what_en: Turns a sunset decision into a phase-gated operational checklist sized to the complexity, with named owners and phases per item, covering data, contracts, access, and money, plus gate criteria, post-EOL actions, and assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the retirement decision is made and an operational plan is needed, typically when you name the product and scale/dates. If no details, it asks up to three questions.

say_en.text: EOL checklist for our legacy reporting module, ending Dec 31, ~400 accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a standard phased checklist with owners.

say_en.text: Heavy EOL checklist for hardware with service contracts and 8 resellers.
say_en.note: Claude will build a full cross-functional playbook.

say_en.text: Light EOL checklist for an internal tool, few users, no contracts.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a short punch list noting skipped phases.
